title: Single forward K useful outputs with learned tiny Mirror codes
purpose: Prioritize one expensive trunk forward -> 4/5 distinct useful task outputs via cheap code, not generic KV or offload. Evaluate native equivalent Givens head fairly.

teacher.base: z(x)=GELU(x @ U) @ D (fixed source teacher shared trunk); U 16x64 and D 64x8
teacher.target: y_m(x)=pairwise_rotate(z(x), true_angles_m) + beta * (tanh(x @ P_m) @ R_m); P_m 16x32, R_m 32x8 independent task-specific private teacher. Scale private component to comparable amplitude using source-training-only standard deviation.
teacher.angles: independent uniform [-0.8,0.8] radians per pair; 4 coefficients per task

train.trainable: only lightweight role output readout, shared trunk frozen

controls: mirror output Givens 4 scalars per task
ordinary Givens head same model class, bytes, FLOPs (M0)
unrestricted task linear readout+bias 72 scalars per task
K independent heavy-trunk recomputations of same canonical statistic as deliberately redundant CPU upper cost
evaluation: pairwise learned output separation normalized by teacher target separation
raw serialized named NPZ bytes including shared U/D and all m versus native head
P50/P95 CPU inference B128 K4/5, 20 warmups,100 measured
exact algebraic 1-forward vs individual output-only computation equality

gates.PASS_mechanism: beta0 mirror NMSE<0.01 and noncollapsed outputs in >=4/5 fresh seeds for K4 and5
gates.FAIL_scope: beta0.8 may require private path; no claim if exceeds NMSE0.1
gates.M0_native_equivalence: ordinary Givens heads identical mathematical class and storage; cannot claim novelty over native multi-head
gates.PASS_cpu_vs_redundant: one heavy forward >=1.5x faster than repeated-K heavy forward in >=4/5 fresh CPU seeds; is not win over native shared trunk linear heads
gates.UNCERTAIN: no GPU/LLM; unknown end-to-end trained shared trunk

protocol_notes: Do not use fresh data or task teacher weight matrices to fit role codes; use train outputs only.
Aligned beta0 synthetic teacher intentionally favors Givens; include beta 0.3,0.8 failure and strong linear head.
A single shared heavy trunk with K independent linear heads is already a baseline capable of one forward; main claims relate to code bytes/function.
Timings are CPU eager, no actual GPU PCIe overlap, no ML model quality generalization.
Never change official worker MA status based on stage0 pilot.
